The Ardougne achievements is a set of Area Tasks subcategories relating to Ardougne and its surrounding area. These subcategories are: Easy Ardougne, Medium Ardougne, Hard Ardougne, and Elite Ardougne.

The NPCs for the easy, medium, hard, and elite subcategories are indicated by a icon on the minimap and the world map. These are Doctor Orbon in the East Ardougne church, the Town crier in the centre of Ardougne, and Aleck in Yanille's Hunter shop, respectively.

The rewards for this set of subcategories include the Ardougne cloak and experience lamps giving a total of 236,500 experience in skills. A player must obtain each Ardougne cloak in sequential order (e.g. medium achievements must be completed before the reward for hard achievements is available).

If the cloak is lost, it can be retrieved from the NPC who gave the player the cloak; Doctor Orbon for the Ardougne cloak 1, the Town crier for the Ardougne cloak 2, and Aleck for the Ardougne cloak 3 and 4.

This set of achievement subcategories is required for the Task Master achievement of the completionist cape.

Completing all achievements in this set of subcategories gives a total of 655 RuneScore.

There are 4 achievements in this group.

Ardougne Set Tasks - EasyGiven by Doctor Orbon in Ardougne Church for completing all Easy Tasks in Ardougne.5

Ardougne Set Tasks - HardGiven by Aleck in Yanille for completing all Hard Tasks in Ardougne.15
Ardougne Set Tasks - EliteGiven by Aleck in Yanille for completing all Elite Tasks in Ardougne.25

Rewards

Talk to Doctor Orbon, who is located in the East Ardougne church, to claim the rewards for the easy achievement set:

  • An antique lamp granting 1,000 experience (in the skill of choice of level 25 or higher)
  • Ardougne cloak 1, which grants the following bonuses:
Reward When worn When operated At all times
Ardougne cloak 1
  • Unlimited teleports to the Ardougne Monastery
  • Some drops from the Creature Creation activity in the Tower of Life will be noted
  • Increasing the success chance of stealing from stalls in Ardougne by 10%
  • Unlimited use of Kandarin monastery Teleport
  • Prayer points are boosted by 10% upon entry to Castle Wars
  • Trading a cat with civilian in West Ardougne gives 200 death runes (instead of 100)
  • 25% chance to spawn an additional chompy bird while hunting chompy birds
Ardougne cloak 2
  • 10 seconds of PvP immunity when teleporting to the Wilderness via the lever in East Ardougne (bugged and doesn't work)
  • Teleport to Manor Farm once a day
    (shares cooldown with Manor farm Teleport)
  • More drops from Creature Creation are noted
  • Increasing the success chance of pickpocketing by 10% in Ardougne
  • A chance of improved yield from crafting runes at the Ourania Runecrafting Altar (approximately 15% more; no extra experience is gained)
  • Use of Manor farm Teleport once per day
  • Ability to toggle the ring of life to teleport to Ardougne (speak to any Ardougne task NPC)
  • Wizard Cromperty will give 700 noted pure essence per week
  • 50% chance to spawn an additional chompy bird while hunting chompy birds
Ardougne cloak 3
  • Stealing from chest in Ardougne Castle or the chest in Chaos Druid Tower will teleport to Ardougne north bank (instead of a random location)
  • Even more of the drops from Creature Creation will be noted (approximately 80%)
  • Increasing the success chance of pickpocketing and stealing from stalls by 10% anywhere in RuneScape
  • Wizard Cromperty will give 1050 noted pure essence per week
  • Watchtower Teleport can be toggled to go to Yanille instead (speak to any Ardougne task NPC)
  • 75% chance to spawn an additional chompy bird while hunting chompy birds
Ardougne cloak 4
  • 5% chance of making two rune crossbow limbs at a time when smithing them in Yanille (currently bugged)
  • Unlimited teleports to Manor Farm
  • Fully restore Summoning points once daily
    (shares cooldown with Summoning globe option)

5You're the Dirty RascalBe on the winning side in a game of Castle Wars.
  • None

Be on the winning side in a game of Castle Wars. A draw will not count. This achievement does not require everyone in the match to be present at the end. It can be completed by having four players join a match, having the player who needs the achievement score, and then the other three players can simply leave via the exit portals. The player wanting the achievement MUST stay until the end of the match, however.

It is possible to complete this achievement with only one other player by doing the following steps:

  1. Go to the Castle Wars lobby with the other player.
  2. One player must enter the Zamorak portal and the other player must enter the Saradomin portal.
  3. Both players logout/go to lobby and re-enter the same world that you were in previously.
  4. Enter the same portals again. A 3 minute countdown should appear if successful.

Afterwards, get 1 point and wait till you win. The other player can leave by waiting a few minutes where they spawned.

It is also possible to exit a match halfway through if your team is losing (and you know that the other team is going to win.) Then enter the winning teams portal to re-join the match on the winning side and get the achievement. Please note however that you can only re-join if someone else leaves the match from the team you are trying to join, so there is a chance that if you leave you might not be able to re-join.

  • 54 Hunter
  • 18 Agility (b)

Successfully pickpocket a watchman on the 1st floor[UK]2nd floor[US] of the Watchtower north of Yanille while wearing the gloves of silence.

To get up to the 1st floor[UK]2nd floor[US] of the Watchtower, players can climb up the trellis on the northern wall of the tower.

Boosts may be used for the Thieving requirement.

15
8It Just CroakedKill a frogeel in the Tower of Life.
  •  Tower of Life

Kill a frogeel in the Tower of Life.

Use a raw cave eel and giant frog legs on the western altar (be careful not to eat the giant frog legs).

15
9Get Your Stinking Hands Off MeHave a monkey minder put you in Ardougne Zoo's monkey cage.
  •  Monkey Madness

Wield the Karamjan monkey greegree while in the Ardougne Zoo and speak to one of the monkey minders to be put in the monkey cage.

15
10Vine-dettaKill your own jade vine after the Back to my Roots quest.
  • 59 Slayer
  • 72 Woodcutting
  • 53 Farming
  •  Back to my Roots

Kill the player grown wild jade vine after the Back to my Roots quest.

Plant a jade vine seed and, optionally, pay Horacio 10 wildblood hops (8 with the master farmer outfit) to protect it. Return to the plant once it is fully grown, and check its health. Do not 'clear' the patch. Instead, the jade vine must be left alone after checking it, for about 3 hours more. After that, it turns wild and becomes a level 72 wild jade vine (which should look like this), which players can kill for 2,500 Slayer experience and 650 Woodcutting experience. Remember to take decent melee weapons (rune or above recommended).

Optionally, a Supreme growth potion (leafy) can be used to instantly grow the wild jade vine. You must still wait several hours for it to turn wild, however.

15
11Living on a PrayerUse the Air Guitar emote near the musician outside the monastery south of Ardougne.
  • 500 music

Use the Air Guitar emote near the musician south-east of the Ardougne Monastery, south of Ardougne.

Quick ways to unlock new music tracks to reach the requirement include exploration, quests, and Dungeoneering.

15
12Who Wants to Watch the Watchtower?Cast the Watchtower Teleport spell.
  • 58 Magic
  •  Watchtower

Cast the Watchtower Teleport spell which requires 2 law runes and 2 earth runes. Teleport tablets do not work.

15
13Monkey BusinessCross the monkey bars in the Yanille Agility Dungeon. One of:
  • 57 Agility (b) or
  • 82 Thieving (b)

Cross the monkeybars from either side in the Yanille Agility dungeon.

The entrance north of Yanille requires a slash weapon to access, and it requires level 57 Agility to cross from northern side. The entrance in southern Yanille requires level 82 Thieving and a lockpick to access. Players do not need to be successful at crossing the monkey bars; a failed attempt will also complete the achievement.

15
14It's My NewtCatch a red salamander from the Hunter area outside of Ourania Altar.
  • 59 Hunter (b)

Catch a red salamander from the Hunter area outside of Ourania Runecrafting Altar.

Requires a small fishing net (tool belt does not work) and a rope to set up traps.

If As a First Resort is completed, players will be able to boost their Hunter skill by 7 levels by using the mud bath in Oo'glog.

It can be feasibly completed by boosting with at least 54 Hunter if the player has the Ourania Teleport spell. Having 54 Hunter allows the player sufficient time for a few attempts at the trap with the mud bath level boost before it decays under level 59. Simply Home Teleport teleport to Oo'glog lodestone and bathe in the mud bath. Step out of it and immediately cast the Ourania Teleport. Upon arrival, run to the young trees and set up a trap as quickly as possible. With a bit of luck, the challenge will be completed rather easily.

15
15A Taste of the ExoticPick a papaya or coconut from the fruit tree patch near Tree Gnome Village.
  • 57 Farming

Pick a papaya or coconut from the fruit tree patch near Tree Gnome Village.

It takes about 16 hours for these trees to grow. It does not have to be a new tree.

15
16Blood Bank WithdrawalAttempt to steal blood runes from the chest in the chaos druid tower's dungeon.
  • 59 Thieving

Attempt to steal blood runes from any of the three chests in the Chaos Druid Tower's dungeon. The attempt does not need to be successful. Merely attempting to open the chest will complete the achievement.

15
17Artillery StrikeUse a catapult in Castle Wars after gaining the knowledge from the Catapult Construction quest.
  •  Catapult Construction

Use a catapult in a Castle Wars game after gaining the knowledge from the Catapult Construction quest.

Just use a rock, found on a table on the ground floor[UK]1st floor[US], with a catapult and shoot. Players do not need to hit anyone or anything. It is strongly recommended to do this when Castle Wars is the spotlighted minigame.

15

  • Ardougne cloak 3, which, in addition to Ardougne cloak 2's bonuses, grants the following bonuses:

  • Wizard Cromperty will give 700 noted pure essence per week

Elite achievements

Requirements

RequirementsSkill requirements are not boostable unless marked with a [B] for boostable.

  • 10 Crafting

Ironmen:
  • 93 Cooking (b)
  • 90 Fishing (if catching the rocktail yourself; lower if fishing from the swarm)
  • 73 Mining (if catching the rocktail yourself; not needed if fishing from the swarm)

  • At least 1 pure essence (Store 1 in the Giant pouch, withdraw it and give it to the Abyssal titan at the altar)
  • 1 Giant pouch

  • 1 Bane bar
  • 1 Magic logs
  • 1 Raw beef or 1 Raw bear meat
  • 1 Abyssal titan pouch

List of achievements

There are 5 achievements in this group.

#NameDescriptionMembersRequirementsNotes
1Catching Some RaysNon-ironman:
Catch a manta ray in the Fishing Trawler activity.

Ironman:
Successfully cook a rocktail on the Witchaven dock.
  • 81 Fishing (b)
Ironmen:
  • 93 Cooking (b)

For non-ironman:

Catch a raw manta ray in the Fishing Trawler minigame. To obtain the raw manta ray, check the trawler net on the docks west of the ship after completing a round. Fishing level boosts such as fishing potions (+3) and admiral pies (+5) may be used. Boosts can be used right before checking the trawler net as the required level does not have to be met during the activity itself. It is a common misconception that this requires finding a group, but the minigame can be played, and the achievement completed, all solo. Players simply need to complete one round of the minigame with a high Fishing level in order to obtain manta rays. Obtaining this fish is not a matter of luck; even catching one fish during the minigame will result in the fish being a manta ray provided players have the requisite Fishing level.

For ironmen:

Successfully cook a rocktail on the Witchaven dock. As there is no range in Witchaven to cook, players must light a fire near Col. O'Niall then cook the rocktail.

25
2Abyssal ValetHave an abyssal titan familiar hold essence for you while runecrafting at Ourania Altar.
  • 93 Summoning

Runecraft at the Ourania Runecrafting Altar while having an abyssal titan familiar hold pure essence.

Essence held in runecrafting pouches will work. However, using a legendary pet with the "Beast of Burden" ability will not; the legendary pet must be dismissed and the Beast of Burden itself summoned using the pouch.

25
3You Could Just KnockAttempt to picklock the door to the basement in Yanille Agility Dungeon.
  • 82 Thieving (b)

Pick the lock on the door to the basement of the Yanille Agility dungeon. A lockpick or hair clip is required to pick the door's lock. The door is near the dungeon's southern entrance, close to the Yanille bank. The door must be unlocked from the southern side, as it is not locked when entered from the north. Temporary skill boost can be used to meet the level 82 Thieving requirement. Despite the official description, the player must succeed in picking the lock to complete the achievement.

25
4Honestly, It's Not a PurseRemove pure or impure essence from a giant pouch at Ourania Altar.
  • 75 Runecrafting
  •  Enter the Abyss (miniquest)

Remove pure or impure essence from a giant pouch at the Ourania Runecrafting Altar. A giant pouch requires level 75 Runecrafting to use and can be bought from Wizard Korvak in the Runecrafting Guild for 50,000 coins or obtained as a drop from abyssal monsters. An expansive pouch will work. Pure essences must be manually removed from pouch for this achievement to count. Crafting essences directly on the altar will consume essences in all pouches but will not count for the achievement.

25
5Almost Made in ArdougneMake a bane crossbow from scratch, performing each step within either Witchaven or Yanille. (X/7)
  • 80 Smithing
  • 83 Fletching
  • 10 Crafting

Make a bane crossbow from scratch, performing each step within either Witchaven or Yanille. A main-hand bane crossbow is required; an off-hand or 2h crossbow will not grant the achievement. Players may obtain magic logs, raw meat, and a bane bar beforehand when completing this achievement. The only meat which will work is raw beef, raw wolf meat, raw bear meat, or raw yak meat.

25
